newsitem.title: SWEDEN: FORECAST-Riksbank to cut repo to 5.25 pct Tuesday.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST-Riksbank to cut repo to 5.25 pct Tuesday.

text.p: Sweden's Riksbank (central bank) is expected to cut its key interest rate, the repo rate, by 15 basis points to 5.25 percent on Tuesday, a Reuter poll of market analysts showed on Tuesday.

All of the 13 analysts in the poll expected the Riksbank to cut by 15 basis points, although one said there was a chance the bank would reduce the rate by 20 basis points and another said it could be limited to 10 basis points.
Although the Bundesbank's reduction of the German repo rate last week was greater than expected, the analysts said the implications for Sweden were limited.
"I don't think we should over-estimate the importance of the German rate cut. The RIksbank will have its own domestic considerations," one economist said.
With an economic recovery on the horizon and inflation bottoming out, analysts said the central bank was likely to reduce the pace of its rate cuts in the near future.

The central rate, now at 5.40 percent is expected to bottom out during the autumn. The other two elements of the Riksbank's interest rate corridor, the deposit and lending rates, are currently set at 4.75 percent and 6.25 percent respectively.
